coach.error: Could not work out the next steps.
coach.how: How the next steps are chosen
coach.howText: Worked out from what this server already holds: your tracked keywords and their ranks, the stored listing, and the competitors you follow. They are ordered by what blocks the rest, then by what moved, then by tidying up. Nothing here is a search volume or a promise of more downloads, and nothing is changed for you. Which fields a store searches is unverified.

rd.chart: Rank of {{terms}} (rank 1 at the top) above {{what}} per day, {{from}} to {{to}}.
rd.delay.apple: Apple reports downloads about 2 days late. The shaded days at the right edge may still change, and a move is not compared until the days after it have settled (through {{date}}).
rd.delay.play: Play files reach this server 3 to 7 days late. The shaded days at the right edge may still change, and a move is not compared until the days after it have settled (through {{date}}).
rd.detail.ok: Downloads per day: {{before}} in the {{beforeDays}} days before, {{after}} in the {{afterDays}} days after ({{pct}}).
rd.detail.tooFew: Not enough days with a download number: {{before}} before and {{after}} after (at least {{min}} each).
rd.detail.waiting: The days after it have not settled yet. Downloads must be settled through {{date}} before they are compared.
rd.detail.waitingLater: The days after it have not settled yet. Downloads must be settled through a later day before they are compared.
rd.gap: The ranks were checked {{count}} days apart, so the move happened on one of those days.
rd.gate.noKeywords: No keywords are tracked for this storefront. Track some to compare their rank with downloads.
rd.gate.tooFew_one: Needs at least {{min}} days of both. This period has {{count}} day with a rank and {{downloadDays}} with downloads.
rd.gate.tooFew_other: Needs at least {{min}} days of both. This period has {{count}} days with a rank and {{downloadDays}} with downloads.
rd.label.ok: Correlation, not proof. Compared {{before}} days before with {{after}} days after.
rd.label.tooFew: Correlation, not proof. {{before}} days before and {{after}} days after had numbers.
rd.label.waiting: Correlation, not proof. Nothing compared yet.
rd.missing.noDownloads: No download numbers are stored for this app and period yet. Sync or import them in Analytics.
rd.missing.noRankChecks: No rank checks of these keywords in this period. Check the keywords first.

terms.step.breakdown: Choose the breakdown "Search term" and the period you want. Pick a country first if you want one country only.
terms.step.english: Switch the console to English before exporting: the column names are read by name and other languages may not be recognised.
terms.step.export: Press "Export report" next to the table and keep the downloaded .csv (or .zip) file.
terms.step.find: Find the report that breaks down store listing visitors by how they found your app. The menus change: type "acquisition" or "search terms" into the search box at the top of the Console, or look under Grow users. Google calls this the user acquisition (organic) report, with a Search row that opens the search terms.
terms.step.open: Open Google Play Console and choose the app.
